scope: Analytic recomputation from the completed real 31B numerical study plus read-only frozen source review. No new model execution, loss change, optimizer construction/step, parameter probe or performance benefit is claimed.

notation.G_i: grad-enabled selected-token log probability at the unchanged initial parameter state theta0
notation.log_mu_i: immutable actual actor behavior log probability; never replaced by rescoring
notation.R_i: the separate no-grad zero-LoRA-scaling learner reference
notation.A: terminal reward minus paired mean, here -0.5 or +0.5

interpretation: A same-forward detached anchor defines a coherent prospective one-step fixed surrogate if the grad-enabled execution is reproducible. It is not algebraically equivalent to the current N-anchored objective when G differs from N.

The first action importance decreases by 14.069%; this is not the percentage change of its complete gradient because the original token-specific exp(G_i-N_i) also disappears. KL weighting changes with rho.
The original study has no active PPO clipping at the initial point. Thus the discrepancy is not fixed by tuning epsilon; no new learning-rate recommendation follows.
Do not remove the independent N measurement or its anomaly merely because the candidate ratio is one. First-call/state/scaling effects can make G itself history-dependent.

Keep the actual actor probabilities and actor identities immutable. Any prospective G-anchor protocol needs a new declared learner objective/execution identity and comparable old-diagnostic records. Changing the reference forward path is a separate change.
fixed_anchor_requirement: Capture old_G = current.detach().clone() exactly once at theta0; detach and freeze rho_G and the independent R as well. Reuse those same arrays for every post-forward and +/- parameter diagnostic. Recomputing current.detach() inside each evaluation makes the PG objective numerically constant while autodiff remains nonzero, so it cannot diagnose a fixed finite-step objective.

minimal_prospective_mode_probe.cold_context: Preserve original N0/R0 under one no_grad+autocast context, then G0 under a fresh grad-enabled autocast context. Insert no observational forwards into this cold triplet.
minimal_prospective_mode_probe.prelude: Preserve original pending-reference completion, which only scores A on the inference reference path, then restore/switch training. A/B-first refers to the training path, not unseen inputs.
minimal_prospective_mode_probe.measurements: Exact selected-token LP arrays, selected predictor hidden summaries, module flags/scaling read without invoking a possibly stateful accessor, per-call timing, parameter identity before/after, explicit graph release; no backward/optimizer.
minimal_prospective_mode_probe.remaining_confound: Cold R and first G are still confounded. If only the cold triplet differs while warm insertion is stable, a separately fresh no-R control is needed before attributing the cause or changing the anchor.

adam_boundary.observed_direction: negative sign of the measured, unclipped focal objective gradient
adam_boundary.fresh_AdamW_weight_decay_zero_formula: g_clip = clip_coefficient*g; delta = -lr*g_clip/(abs(g_clip)+eps), before actual FP32 operation/parameter rounding. The bias corrections cancel beta1/beta2 on a genuinely fresh first step.
adam_boundary.resumed_Adam_formula: For each parameter with grad present, calculate copied m_next=beta1*m+(1-beta1)*g_clip, v_next=beta2*v+(1-beta2)*g_clip^2 and per-parameter step_next; apply bias corrections and eps in the actual implementation order. Skip grad=None parameters exactly as the optimizer does. Never mutate live moments or weights.
prospective_math_only_measurements: actual optimizer hyperparameters and fresh/bound state identity
g dot hypothetical delta and hypothetical FP32-rounded delta
hypothetical step RMS and nonzero count
gradient-magnitude/epsilon attenuation counts and sign-direction cosine
adam_boundary.no_current_reconstruction: This study report contains gradient norm/L1-derived directional summaries, not every gradient tensor or Adam moment. The actual Adam delta cannot be recovered now from those aggregates.
adam_boundary.restriction: In a later authorized zero-update diagnostic, calculate candidates on copies using the actual measured gradients and pinned runtime semantics; do not construct/call optimizer.step, accept/select a step or write the candidate into the model. No learning-rate inference from the two sign probes.

accessor_cold_observation.finding: Ordinary NF4 branch directly reads proj.scaling without a scaling cache. General accessor can call TP/fake-quant/MXFP4 helpers or write FP8 block_size attributes; therefore cold observation must not make additional accessor calls merely on the assumption it is pure.

fresh_adam_first_order_sign_gap_bound.source: Existing real31B directional derivative/L1 and nonzero count; analytic bound, no new model execution

fresh_adam_first_order_sign_gap_bound.boundary: This tightens the first-order distinction: epsilon damping alone changes ideal fresh-step linear prediction by at most about0.1011%. It bounds neither the finite BF16 forward loss difference nor coordinate displacement, FP32 rounding, resumed-moment direction or learning-rate quality.

later_actual_modes_FP32_importance_recom.scope: Analytic recomputation from existing R5/R6/R7 vectors and immutable actor behavior. No new model/GPU/optimizer execution, tolerance or loss change. Earlier R4 sections remain intact.

formula.behavior_operand: Round archived actor behavior to FP32, matching current.new_tensor before the implementation converts operands to double. N and G records are exact FP32 selected-logprob values.
formula.log_importance: sum_i(L_i.double - behavior_FP32_i.double), L=N or same-forward detached G
formula.fixed_anchor: Any proposed G anchor and rho must be captured once and held fixed across probes; never recompute current.detach inside every evaluation.

phase_mapping.r7: Post-backward legacy N/G; candidate/restored exactness is established separately, not assumed here
